title: ExternalIdentity
description: An identity asserted by an external identity provider, mapped to a canonical principal. The canonical resolution key is always issuer + subject (ADR-0004 / ADR-IAM-0019). provider_type is optional operational metadata only and MUST NOT gate platform authorization.

issuer.description: The issuer URL of the external identity provider.

provider_type.description: Optional operational label for the identity engine implementation (e.g. keycloak, ory, google, azure, unknown). Free string — not an enum locked to a single provider. MUST NOT be required for correctness; MUST NOT be used as the authorization key (use issuer + subject).
